exit 0
--- stdout
Record implementation intent, validation plan, and scope before submission.
Requirements:
- Agent ID must be provided (via --agent-id flag or LIZA_AGENT_ID env var)
- Task must be in an executing status (resolved from pipeline config)
- Task must be assigned to the submitting agent
Updates:
- Appends pre_execution_checkpoint event to task history
- Does not change task status
Usage:
liza write-checkpoint <task-id> [flags]
Flags:
--agent-id string agent identifier (overrides LIZA_AGENT_ID env var; legacy env alias is also accepted)
--assumptions strings tagged assumptions
--files-to-modify strings files that will be modified (omit for read-only analysis tasks)
-h, --help help for write-checkpoint
--impact string impact classification (standard, significant, architecture)
--intent string specific, observable intent of implementation (required)
--json output result as structured JSON
--risks string identified risks
--scope-extensions string scope extensions as JSON array, e.g. [{"file":"path","justification":"why"}]
--tdd-not-required string justification for skipping new test files
--validation-plan string concrete validation command and expected output (required)
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
